rule: For a species that newly reaches the unexplored-candidate threshold, the same two queries as scripts/build_unexplored_candidates.py: the OBIS checklist of its WoRMS genus in the map box, and the GBIF speciesKey facet of the same genus over the box with coordinates. A genus whose only species in the box is the relative itself adds no 미탐색 후보, so the reviewed species and their cells stay as last reviewed and only the relatives lists are rewritten. A genus with any other species needs the full build (network).
